title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
description:
The role 
 HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.
 As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and  felt . You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me .
 This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.
 What you’ll do 
 Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.
 The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.
 Cross-Org Data Supplier : You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.
 AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow. You don't treat AI as a novelty; it's a genuine speed and quality multiplier in your daily practice.
 Long-Horizon Strategy You manage your domain with real autonomy. You run a flywheel: better profile data → better models → more visible personalization → more signal back to personalization. You own the strategy and sequencing, not just the backlog, thinking 12–18 months out and making the calls that shape the direction of the team.
 What you’ll bring 
 Deep personalization or data-collection PM experience. 5+ years of PM experience, with meaningful time on user-facing personalization or data collection products, ideally where the UX is the data pipeline, and where you've shipped for both end customers and downstream data consumers.
 Strong product taste and customer-facing craft. You have a genuine feel for what makes a consumer experience compelling, trustworthy, and sticky, not just functional. You've built products at scale where millions of people interact with what you ship, and you hold a high bar for the details: the copy, the interaction pattern, the moment of delight. You know the difference between a feature that works and one that earns trust.
 Data-native. You query your own data (SQL/Python), define your own input/output KPIs, and hold your own in deep-dive technical discussions without needing a data analyst to translate.
 Cross-org credibility. You've shipped products across organizational boundaries, aligning on shared metrics, maintaining clean contracts with engineering partners, and navigating competing priorities without direct authority.
 Experimentation with healthy skepticism. You design experiments to validate hypotheses and know how to interpret results without over-indexing on noise. You've made hard calls to kill features based on data.
 Exceptional communicator. You can make a complex algorithmic concept legible to a non-technical VP and you can write a spec that engineers can actually ship from.
 The AI edge. You've already incorporated AI-assisted workflows into your daily practice to increase speed, depth of insight, and output quality.
 What we offer 
 Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.
 Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
 Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
 Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
 Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
 Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Product Manager, Switchboard
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Senior Product Manager for Switchboard, you'll shape how customers manage their GitLab Dedicated infrastructure and how our engineering teams operate a growing fleet of customer instances. Switchboard is the control plane for Dedicated: it helps internal teams scale upgrades and maintenance, while giving customers a place to configure their infrastructure, understand the health of their environment, and receive critical updates.
 You'll own the product vision and roadmap, balancing technical and operational needs with a clear, useful customer experience. Dedicated is GitLab's fastest-growing deployment option, and your work will help the business support more customers efficiently. You'll have the autonomy to identify the most important problems and decide where Switchboard should go next, with support from your manager and engineering partners.
 What you’ll do 
 Set the vision and roadmap for Switchboard, connecting customer needs and internal operational challenges to priorities for the engineering team.
 Work with engineering and site reliability engineering teams to improve the tools used to operate Dedicated instances, including upgrades and maintenance.
 Improve the customer-facing console so customers can manage infrastructure settings, configure private networking and authentication, and understand their instance's health.
 Talk directly with customers to understand their needs, explain product decisions, and use their feedback to shape the roadmap.
 Bring a strong user experience perspective to product decisions. Work hands-on with engineering to develop and refine workflows, including when a dedicated design partner isn't available.
 Explore opportunities to improve the tooling and experience for customers migrating from self-managed GitLab to Dedicated, how we help manage incidents, and to extend Switchboard to support GitLab.com as its architecture evolves.
 What you’ll bring 
 Experience owning a product vision and roadmap and working with engineering to deliver improvements for users.
 Technical understanding that helps you discuss infrastructure and operational tradeoffs with engineers and translate them into clear product decisions.
 A strong focus on user experience, with experience making complex technical workflows easier to understand and use.
 Clear communication and the ability and interest to work directly with customers. Experience with internal tools is relevant, provided you're comfortable taking on customer-facing product work.
 The ability to work independently, make sense of an evolving problem space, and prioritize across customer experience, operational efficiency, and business needs.
 You may also bring experience with control planes, cloud management consoles, infrastructure products, internal operational tools, customer migrations, or incident management, but these aren't required. 
 About the team 
 We work across product management, engineering, and site reliability engineering to solve technical, operational, and user experience problems.
 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

 Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.

title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.
The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 
How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?
About Nelly
We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
Joining us, you will:
 - Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money
 - Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany
 - Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start
 - Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do
 - Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs
What you'll bring:
 - Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk
 - Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward
 - Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation
 - Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers
 - You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product
 - 7+ years of product management experience
Even better if you have:
 - Built and shipped AI products
 - Worked on data platforms or data products
 - Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry
 - Professional German language knowledge
Our Interview Process:
 - Introduction to Nelly with TA
 - Product craft interview with our Product manager
 - Case study interview with Director of Product
 - Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders
What we offer:
 - The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.
 - Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.
 - A yearly learning and development budget, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. 
 - A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.
 - Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast.
 - Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance.
 - Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup.
 - Up to 4 weeks of workation.
 - A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with.
We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fintech

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
Meet the team:
As a product team, our goal is to improve the life of our students and our tutors, drive amazing learning outcomes for our learners and enable our tutors to financially thrive through the platform. Welcome to the good side of tech 👋
You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?
Docplanner at scale
We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.
At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.
We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.es/Overview/Working-at-DocPlanner-EI_IE1071394.11,21.htm?countryRedirect=true speak for themselves. And why should you join us?
Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.
We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further. You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.
You will be responsible for:
 - Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
 - Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
 - Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
 - Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
 Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
 - Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
 - Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
 - Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
 Owning paid visibility and growth products
 - Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
 - Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
 Working data-first
 - Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
 - Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
 - Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.

title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description:
We're looking for a **Staff Product Manager** to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.
**The problem space:** Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces.
How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?
**About Nelly**
We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
**Why?** Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
**What sets us apart:** We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
**Joining us, you will:**
* Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money
* Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany
* Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start
* Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do
* Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs
**What you'll bring:**
* Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk
* Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward
* Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation
* Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers
* You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product
* 7+ years of product management experience
**Even better if you have:**
* Built and shipped AI products
* Worked on data platforms or data products
* Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry
* Professional German language knowledge

* Introduction to Nelly with TA
* Product craft interview with our Product manager
* Case study interview with Director of Product
* Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders
**What we offer:**
* **The people you get to work with.** You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.
* **Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else.** New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.
* **A yearly learning and development budget**, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning.
* **A front row seat while we build something big.** We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
description:
WER WIR SIND 
 Wir bei Wire bieten sichere Kommunikation für Regierungen, Verteidigungsorganisationen und regulierte Unternehmen in ganz Europa. Die Entwicklung von Messaging Layer Security (MLS) haben wir mitgeprägt und gehören heute zu den Vorreitern beim produktiven Einsatz im großen Maßstab, mit Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselten Nachrichten, Anrufen und Dateifreigaben. Unsere Government Edition verfügt über eine BSI-Zulassung für die Kommunikation auf VS-NfD-Niveau im Rahmen des zugelassenen Einsatzbereichs.
 ALLGEMEINE INFORMATIONEN 
 Anstellungsart: Festanstellung
 Berufserfahrung: Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Produktmanagement im B2B- oder Enterprise-Technologieumfeld
 Arbeitszeit: 40 Std./Woche
 Arbeitsort: Berlin / hybrid in Deutschland
 Berichtet an: Director of Product
 Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch auf mindestens C1-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift
 Wunsch-Startdatum: Schnellstmöglich
 DEINE CHALLENGE BEI WIRE 
 Als Senior Product Manager, German Public Sector & Defence sorgst du dafür, dass Wire das richtige Produkt für einen seiner strategisch wichtigsten Märkte entwickelt. Du verbindest Kunden- und Marktarbeit mit Produktführung über einen oder mehrere unserer Value Streams, etwa Messaging, Calling, File Sharing und Core-Plattform-Funktionen. Dabei entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Kunden aus dem deutschen öffentlichen Sektor und der Verteidigung und bringst diesen Kontext in unsere Produktorganisation ein.
 Dies ist keine Rolle im operativen Delivery Management. Scope Teams und Engineering Teams verantworten Backlogs, agile Prozesse und Delivery. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Teams die richtigen Probleme aus den richtigen Gründen lösen und dass Produktinvestitionen an Kundenbedarf, Commercial Opportunity und der Strategie von Wire ausgerichtet bleiben.
 Kunden, Markt und Commercial 
 Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Kunden, Interessenten und Partnern auf und vertrittst die Produktorganisation von Wire in Produktgesprächen auf Senior-Ebene.
 Gemeinsam mit Sales und Partnerships arbeitest du an großen Vertriebschancen, RFPs und Ausschreibungen, bringst glaubwürdige Produktexpertise ein und bewertest Kundenanforderungen.
 Du hast die Commercial Pipeline, strategische Kundenzusagen und neue Marktchancen im Blick.
 Produktausrichtung und Value Streams 
 Du stimmst mit einem oder mehreren Value Streams klare Ziele, angestrebte Ergebnisse und Prioritäten ab, im Einklang mit der Produktstrategie von Wire.
 Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedarfe in klar formulierte Produktprobleme und Chancen für Scope Teams und Engineering Teams.
 Du bringst Kunden-, Commercial- und Geschäftskontext in wichtige Produkt- und Priorisierungsentscheidungen ein, damit die Teams die Gründe hinter den Prioritäten verstehen.
 Du erkennst Abhängigkeiten über Value Streams hinweg und koordinierst die Produktausrichtung, wenn Kundenbedarfe mehrere Teile der Wire-Plattform betreffen.
 Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit 
 Du arbeitest eng mit Information Security zusammen, wenn Kundenanforderungen Security, Assurance, Akkreditierung oder Regulierung betreffen, bei klarer Trennung der Verantwortlichkeiten zwischen Product und Security.
 Gemeinsam mit Product Marketing und dem Commercial-Team stellst du sicher, dass Fähigkeiten und Ausrichtung des Produkts im Markt korrekt dargestellt werden.
 Deine Ziele im ersten Jahr 
 Du baust vertrauensvolle Arbeitsbeziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden, Interessenten und Commercial-Stakeholdern aus Regierung und Verteidigung in Deutschland auf.
 Du stimmst klare Ziele für die Value Streams ab, die du betreust, und gibst eine klare Produktrichtung für die wertvollsten produktübergreifenden Chancen vor.
 DEIN PROFIL 
 Was du mitbringst 
 Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit hochrangigen Kunden und Commercial-Stakeholdern und darin, deren Bedarfe in eine Produktrichtung zu übersetzen.
 Ausgeprägtes Produkturteil: Du trennst zugrunde liegende Kundenprobleme von gewünschten Lösungen und einzelne Anfragen von übergreifenden Marktchancen.
 Erfahrung darin, Produktziele und Ergebnisse zu setzen und die Prioritäten von Scope Teams und Engineering Teams zu beeinflussen.
 Ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, glaubwürdig mit technischen und nicht-technischen Zielgruppen zu kommunizieren und klare Abwägungen zu treffen.
 Ein starkes Plus 
 Erfahrung mit dem deutschen öffentlichen Sektor oder Verteidigungsorganisationen wie Bundeswehr, BWI, BAAINBw, Bundesministerien oder deren Zulieferern, idealerweise mit einem eigenen Netzwerk in diesem Umfeld.
 Erfahrung mit Produkten für Kunden aus Regierung, Verteidigung, kritischer Infrastruktur oder anderen stark regulierten Bereichen sowie mit öffentlicher Beschaffung und komplexen Vertriebszyklen.
 Erfahrung mit sicherer Kommunikation, Collaboration-Software, Enterprise SaaS oder sicherheitsorientierten Technologieprodukten.
 Verständnis der Anforderungen an digitale Souveränität in Deutschland und Europa.
 Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Produktteams oder Value Streams hinweg.
 Eine bestehende Ü2/Ü3-Sicherheitsüberprüfung oder die Voraussetzungen und Bereitschaft, diese zu durchlaufen.
 WARUM WIRE? 
 Werde Teil eines marktbewährten Unternehmens mit mehr als 1.000 Kunden und hilf mit, Wire zum vertrauenswürdigen Partner für sichere Kommunikation zu machen, für Organisationen, denen Sicherheit und Privatsphäre besonders am Herzen liegen.
 Beteilige dich über VSOPs am langfristigen Erfolg von Wire.
 30 Tage Urlaub, damit du dir verdiente Auszeiten nehmen und eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance halten kannst.
 Mit einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft bleibst du ausgeglichen sowie mental und körperlich gesund.
 Wir investieren in deine berufliche Entwicklung, mit einem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € und Zugang zu erstklassigen Lernressourcen.
 Arbeite in unserem schönen Büro im Herzen Berlins oder wähle eine Mischung aus Arbeiten von überall und ausgewählten gemeinsamen

title: Founders Associate – CEO Office (m/w/d)
description:
#### **About Recare**
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.
#### **This is what you can expect from us as a Founder’s Associate (m/w/d):**
* **Work with Purpose** — Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals. By helping our CEO and leadership team turn priorities into action, you contribute to improving healthcare.
* **Work Closely with Our Founder** — Gain direct exposure to company-building, strategic decisions, and leadership. You’ll take ownership of meaningful work and see its impact across the business.
* **Corporate Culture** — We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work towards common goals and expect the same from you.
* **Flexibility** — As a remote-first company, we offer flexible working hours and the flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany. By arrangement, you’re also welcome to take a workation.
* **Probonio** — Choose a benefit that suits you best, from gift cards to fitness.
* **Professional Development** — Your development matters to us. We support you in building your capabilities, taking on responsibility, and growing in your role.
* **Extra Day Off on Your Birthday** — So you can celebrate with your loved ones.
#### **This is how you will make an impact as a Founder’s Associate:**
Your mission is to make our founder more effective every week. Working directly with our CEO, Max, you will help turn company priorities into a clear leadership rhythm, well-prepared decisions, and reliable execution.
* **Keep the CEO focused on what matters.** Manage priorities, coordinate the founder’s agenda, and prepare key internal and external meetings so that time and attention go towards the highest-impact topics.
* **Run our leadership rhythm.** Own the preparation and follow-through of our Exec Sync and other leadership formats—from agendas and pre-reads to decision logs and action tracking.
* **Turn strategy into accountability.** Support Max in running our Must-Win Battles goal framework. Coordinate review cycles, make progress and blockers visible, and follow up with directors on their commitments on behalf of the CEO.
* **Close the loop on decisions.** Track CEO and leadership decisions through implementation, ensuring clear owners, deadlines, and timely escalation when work gets stuck.
* **Prepare clear, compelling communication.** Draft CEO communications, presentations, and briefing materials for internal audiences, customers, hospitals, and other external stakeholders.
* **Drive selected strategic projects.** Take ownership of time-boxed, cross-company initiatives—from structuring the problem to coordinating delivery and handing over to a clear long-term owner.
* **Put AI into practice in the CEO Office.** Become a hands-on user of agents built on Recare’s internal AI operating system. Help embed them into daily workflows while ensuring their use meets Recare’s governance and project standards.
#### **Your Profile:**
* **You have experience turning priorities into results.** You bring relevant experience from a founder’s office, business operations, consulting, project management, or another fast-paced environment where you coordinated complex work and delivered outcomes.
* **You bring structure to ambiguity.** You can break an open-ended challenge into clear questions, priorities, owners, and next steps—without creating unnecessary process.
* **You follow through.** You are organized, dependable, and comfortable keeping senior stakeholders accountable. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to escalate.
* **You communicate with clarity and judgment.** You can turn complex information into concise briefings, effective presentations, and actionable meeting materials.
* **You build trust across functions.** You collaborate confidently with senior leaders and colleagues, challenge constructively, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* **You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.** You are as comfortable preparing a decision as you are maintaining an action tracker or coordinating the details that make a meeting productive.
* **You are curious about AI and thoughtful about its use.** You enjoy testing tools, improving workflows, and applying AI responsibly to practical business problems.
* **You care about making healthcare work better.** You are motivated by meaningful impact and want to help build a company that improves the experience of patients and healthcare professionals.
We’re looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Program Manager Electronic Systems (m/w/d), Low Voltage Architecture, Berlin
description:
What To Expect
 Join Vehicle Engineering in Berlin to help launch the next generation of cutting-edge automotive products for Tesla. Our world-class engineering teams operate with a non-conventional automotive product development philosophy of high interdisciplinary collaboration, flat organizational structure, and technical contribution at all levels. You will be expected to challenge and be challenged, to create, to innovate. You must want to work in a fast-paced environment company. We are building real products. This must excite you.
This role focuses on defining, driving, and implementing program requirements for Low Voltage Harnesses and electrical components in the portfolio of Electronic Systems, from concept development to mass production and sustaining across Tesla factory locations in Fremont, Shanghai, and Berlin. Collaboration with cross-functional teams including Design Studio, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, NPI, Production, and Service is essential to establish a new program cadence and ensure successful global implementation.
 What You'll Do
 Define and drive program requirements, workflows, and timelines for Electronic Systems from concept to mass production
 Collaborate with suppliers to align their timelines with program deliverables and manage engineering changes impacting cost and timing
 Establish a roadmap to support the launch of new features and functionality in the product lineup
 Facilitate system design reviews to encourage the maturation of engineering design topics for early development, closure of launch issues, etc.
 Lead global pilot launches by building cross-functional partnerships and driving results across the organization
 Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and provide actionable solutions to ensure program readiness and timely delivery
 Document milestones, monitor schedules, and update program plans to maintain accurate progress tracking
 Support Tesla test engineering teams and suppliers to execute DVP plans and ensure timely validation of systems and components
 What You'll Bring
 Education in Mechanical, Mechatronic or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
 Experience in product development, ideally with multiple delivered products in medium-to-high volume industries
 Motivated, active collaborator with interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills for working in a highly cross-functional environment
 Experience in fast-paced settings with end-to-end product deployment from concept through successful launch
 Knowledge of electrical interfaces and vehicle architectures with familiarity in BOM, 3DX PLM, and cross-functional collaboration
 Ability to manage diverse teams and work cross-functionally with attention to detail and strong organizational skills
 Proficiency in project management and communication tools such as Confluence, Jira, and scheduling software

description:
[ Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company . This position can be performed remotely from multiple countries around the world. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]
 About Quora
 Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:
 Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.
 Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.
 Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.
 This role will be working on our Quora product.
 About The Team And Role
 Our product managers excel at and are responsible for guiding, enabling, and accelerating the efforts of our designers, engineers, and data scientists to build and ship successful products. Even though we've experienced significant growth, we're still a small team where each PM needs to own a significant portion of the product experience, so in this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive company-level impact, influence overall company strategy, and interface regularly with product leadership and the executive team.
We're looking for a Product Manager to lead user-centric growth initiatives across Quora's core product experience , focused on expanding our top-of-funnel acquisition, improving activation, and unlocking new growth levers across web and mobile. This includes crafting engaging user experiences, running a high-velocity experimentation program, aligning cross-functional teams, and generating user insights that inform long-term platform strategy.
 Responsibilities
 Own the end-to-end user growth funnel, with a focus on top-of-funnel acquisition, activation, and early retention across web and mobile surfaces
 Deeply understand users both on and off the platform and build engaging experiences that expand Quora’s reach to new demographics
 Manage ambiguity, complexity, and cross-functional interdependencies in a fast-paced environment, doing what it takes to make the product successful
 Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and product operations to define, build, iterate, and ship high-quality growth experiences at scale
 Define objectives, metrics, and guardrails to guide prioritization and measure success
 Run structured experimentation across the funnel, using quantitative and qualitative insights to inform product strategy and roadmap
 Monitor and analyze industry and product trends to identify new strategic growth levers that drive user growth, audience expansion, and product retention
 Minimum Requirements
 Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)
 5+ years combined experience in Product Management
 Demonstrated experience driving user growth on a consumer product, with a track record of measurable impact on acquisition, activation, or retention metrics
 Excellent communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level -- within teams, within the company, to users, and other audiences
 Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to drive decisions and scale products through experimentation
 Strong foundation in user research and design principles, with a track record of leveraging insights to launch winning user experiences
 Preferred Requirements
 Experience working on user-generated content (UGC) platforms, marketplaces, aggregators, or content-driven consumer products
 Experience growing UGC products with heavy SEO traffic and a strong understanding of organic search as an acquisition channel
 BA/BS degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
 At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.
 Additional Information
 We are accepting applications on an ongoing basis.
Quora offers a wide range of benefits including medical/dental/vision coverage, equity refreshers, remote work reimbursement, paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more. Benefits are country-specific and may vary.
